title: Topological Sort
intuition: Sort vertices of a DAG linearly such that for every directed edge uv, vertex u comes before v.
step_by_step_strategy: While queue is not empty, dequeue node, decrement neighbor in-degrees.
If a neighbor's in-degree reaches 0, enqueue it.
common_mistakes: Failing to detect cycle loops (if sorted nodes < total nodes, cycle exists)
content: Sort vertices of a DAG linearly such that for every directed edge uv, vertex u comes before v.
